basis: Existing dm4 A/B recordings only. No new matches, compile, cohorts or deployment.
problem: Explosive shots into nearby overhead/corner geometry while fighting on dm4 walkways.

evidence.observation: Camera HUD changes from TACTICAL to COMBAT; rocket firing is followed by a close explosion against overhead/corner masonry. This does not prove the source of damage or deaths.

source_finding: Argus_Combat checks actual-shot240u muzzle clearance only under if(self.ar_tactic); ordinary RL combat bypasses that guard. Existing lead-point geometry checks are not the same as checking the final imperfect firing direction.

one_change.location: Existing actual imperfect shot direction guard after self.v_angle is assigned
one_change.preserve: Existing movement calculation and tactical240u/abort rule. Grenades and non-tactical hitscan unchanged. No health/inventory or incoming-projectile perception changes.
one_change.ordinary_probe_limit: For ordinary RL only, cap clearance at the nearer of240u and the intended aim-point distance, so a wall behind a close opponent does not veto the shot. Leave the existing tactical240u probe unchanged.

expected_effect: Hold an unsafe ordinary rocket for a moment while normal movement clears the obstruction; avoid visibly wasteful near-wall impacts and possible self-splash. Impact remains a hypothesis until controlled checks.
risk: May defer a useful close-wall splash shot; do not claim gameplay improvement from footage alone.
minimal_future_verification: Controlled ordinary-RL near-corner/overhang case: blocked actual shot holds fire and spends no ammo, movement still proceeds.
Same case with clear firing direction: ordinary RL still fires normally.
Close visible target with wall behind it: do not veto solely because the backdrop falls inside240u.
Existing tactical muzzle veto/abort and a non-RL control remain unchanged.
decision: Keep step1a in development. Step1b and projectile perception stay parked/held. Propose only; no implementation authority assumed.
